note: Tests ran at b510ed2 plus this change on Node 26.13.0, with TYPESAFE_API_KEY unset: 31 plain test files that import a changed file (212 tests) green; 25 libfabrika integration files green, apart from IsolateUsage.integration.test.ts U7 and U8, which timed out at 60 s and 20 s while another session loaded the box and passed 7 of 7 when run alone (that file only calls StartsTest.fixture data-first); 8 app and pipeline integration files (220 tests) green, so the 0178 guard refused none.
